prompt: Aisha plans to run at 6am because she values feeling fitter in three months, but she keeps skipping. Which change best strengthens the habit loop right now?

options.text: Add an immediate, enjoyable reward straight after the run, such as a favourite breakfast and ticking a visible calendar
Remind herself more strongly that fitness matters in three months
Make the run longer so the long-term benefit feels larger
Skip any reward so the habit becomes purely disciplined

explanation: Distant benefits are weak motivators in the moment. An immediate reward after the routine helps the loop repeat until the behaviour itself becomes more familiar.
